review.note: The article this item's own English sitelink names, "Action at Tamanana, 9 September 1645", is a redirect to the broader article "Insurrection of Pernambuco", and that is the article the summary quotes and the citation names: the lead is the insurrection's and not this action's. The insurrection's § Course does describe the action, citing Marley 2008 at p. 204. A reviewer should replace the quoted paragraph with an account of the action itself.

title: Action at Tamanana, 9 September 1645
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Insurrection of Pernambuco", at revision 1370623843, opens: "The Insurrection of Pernambuco, also known as the War of the Divine Light, was a movement against Dutch rule in the Captaincy of Pernambuco. The revolution occurred in the course of the second Dutch invasion during the Dutch–Portuguese War and resulted in the expulsion of the Dutch from the northeast region of Brazil, followed by the reclamation of the territory by the Kingdom of Portugal." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q121365322, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
